translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: 2 PEDRO
book.title: An tsabchilab u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pedro

content: A Pedro in thuchanchal an u ax u belomchic c’al a Jesucristo

Nana’ in Simón Pedro tin t’ojnalil ani tin abathualejil a Jesucristo tu thuchanchal axe’ xi u tata’chic ax it pithnenec i huinat alhua’talab abal ca bela’ a Jesucristo jant’ini’ huahua’ i belal. Cum lej pututh i Diosil ani i Jec’onthaxil Jesucristo jats ta bajumalits antsana’ ca bela’.
Ca más alhua’ exlaye a Dios ani i Ajatic Jesús ani ne’ets quit más lubach co’onchat a ichich c’al in alhua’ inictal a Dios ani ne’ets quit más ejetbethanchat a ichich.
Am belomchic quin luba’ tim ba’
A Dios c’al in tsap tu pithamalits patal abal cu it ejatliyat ani cu c’uajiy utat c’al jaja’. I exlalits jaja’ ax tu tacuyamalchic abal qui eynanchi in ts’alat ani in alhua’.

Ja’its tin ebal in ts’alat ani in alhua’ tu bijchith uchamalits lej yan ani lej huinat alhua’ ne’ets tucu t’ajchi ani tucu pitha’. C’al im bijchith cahuintal tu ichichliyal ejtil in ichich jaja’, ani jaxtam tu hualcanthal c’al i hualbith le’nomtal.
Jaxtam in tomnal qui lej luba’ cu xe’tsin alhua’ biyat i belal a Dios. Ani yab expith cu xe’tsin alhua’, jaye qui luba’ qui más exlaye a Dios.

Ani yab expith qui exlaye más a Dios, jaye qui luba’ qui alhua’ beletna’ ti ba’. Ani yab expith qui alhua’ beletna’ ti ba’, jaye qui luba’ qui lej ne’tha’ cuxuth i ichich c’al jahuaquitsq’ui qui tamu. Ani yab expith qui ne’tha’ cuxuth i ichich c’al jahuats qui tamu, jaye qui luba’ cu c’uajiy utat c’al a Dios.

Ani yab expith cu c’uajiy utat c’al a Dios, jaye qui luba’ cu c’uajiy ichich hual ts’ot’c’óthlith tu ebchalab c’al a Cristo. Ani yab expith antsana’ cu c’uajiy tu ebchalab, jaye qui luba’ qui baju tu lej c’anithom c’al patal an inicchic.
Max antsana’ ca lejat bajuhuitschic ca t’aja’ jahua’ tu ucha’its, ne’ets quit lej eyentha tin t’ojlabil a Dios ani exbath ne’ets ca junini’ exla’ i Ajatic Jesucristo.
Max i ca bajuchic, ejtil max it hue’ joc’tsiye a tsu’tal expith jahua’ utat. A uc’chiyamalits abal a Dios ti jayq’ui’ ti paculanchi a hualab.

Jaxtam ebchalabchic, ca luba’ ca exla’ ta ichich max chubax it canithits ani it tacuthits tit c’alab c’al a Dios. Max ca t’aja’ patal axe’ jahua’ nan tu ucha’its, tam a Dios ne’ets ti lej lotocna’ ani ni jayq’ui’ yab ne’ets ti bithlou ta c’ubac quit ijcan.
Taley a Dios ne’ets ti bats’uchic c’al tsab in c’ubac tam quit ulits ti eb quit c’uajiychic jun tin t’ajal i Ajatic ani i Jec’onthaxil Jesucristo ti lej Ts’ale abal ets’ey.
Aba ani’ a tso’obitschic ani lej alhua’ t’aychithits an chubaxtalab ta ichich, bel ne’ets tu huilq’uith t’iloxnanchi jahua’ nan tu olchamalits.
Biyat in xe’etse teje’ tsabal u tsalpayal abal in tomnal antsana’ tu t’iloxnanchi abal tu bacchi a ichich c’al an chubaxtalab.
Cum tin tso’obliyamalits i Ajatic Jesucristo abal yabats ne’ets quin ohuey teje’ tsabal.
Jaxtam u lubal abal tu t’aychiye ta ichich an chubaxtalab abal ca junini’ t’ilonaye tam nan in tsemenecaquits.
Ax in tsu’u abal a Cristo in cua’al in tsap

Yab pel i t’ilab ts’ejcath c’al in tsalpathtal an inic axi huahua’ tu exobchamal tata’chic tin cuenta in tsap i Ajatic Jesucristo ani tin cuenta abal ne’ets ca chich junil. I tsu’u c’al i lej hual tam ti jalc’uthme jilc’on lej tajajal in hual.

I Tata Dios tu tejhua’methanchi abal lej pulic in ey ani in lej cua’al in tsap an Ajatic. Ma tin ts’alat coytal ti eb in ucha’ a Dios tin cuenta an Ajatic antse’: Jats u c’an Tsacamil ani in lej culbel c’al jaja’.
Ja’its an lej cau ax i ats’a’ tal ti eb tam tu c’uajatac c’al an Ajatic ti al an t’ocat bolchal.

Hua’ats jaye axi lej c’athpich chubax an cau tin cuenta an Ajatic thuchath tin uhuil am biyal caulomechic c’al a Dios. Jats xe’ in tomnal qui lej t’aja’ ti cuenta cum pel in ey ejtil i tajablab ax tu tajbanchal i ichich. Max qui lej t’aja’ ti cuenta, ejtil max ne’ets ca chuthey alabel ti ichich, cum an Ajatic ejtil a pulic ot ne’ets ca tajc’an ti ichich.
Qui lej alhua’ tso’obna’ abal ni jita’ tam inic yab in ejtohual quin ejtiy c’al in cuete’ tsalap jahua’ thuchath ti al an T’ocat Thuchlab c’al in caulomejilchic a Dios.
Cum jahua’ in olnamalits nixe’ xi biyal t’ocat caulomechic yab ja in cuete’ cahuintal, pel xe’ i cau axi pithnenecchic c’al an Espíritu Santo.
